headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates fell short in Atlanta, losing 2-3 to the Braves. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Bubba Chandler pitched 5.1 strong innings with 7 strikeouts.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. The Houston Astros have placed shortstop Nick Allen on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Additionally, the Seattle Mariners have placed J.P. Crawford on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 6, 2026, with a right hand contusion.

Several teams have made roster moves in recent days. The Colorado Rockies acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers. The Rockies also acquired Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics in a separate trade. The Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dropped a 2-3 decision to the Atlanta Braves in their latest matchup. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Bubba Chandler pitched 5.1 strong innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings for the White Sox, striking out 3 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dropped a 4-6 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays in their latest matchup. Taylor Ward led the Orioles' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Adam Macko earned the win with a strong relief appearance.

top_news.title: **Astros Place Nick Allen on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have placed shortstop Nick Allen on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Richie Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers.
